title: Org Bridge: Hub Standup & Rapid Priorities — Jul 12 2027
content:
Attendees: Aisha (host), Ethan, Marina, Kenji, Priya, Talia, guests from SRE and Console.

Purpose: rapid org-level sync to surface week priorities, risks, and quick decisions. Not a replacement for team retros — this is triage/coordination for cross-cutting blockers.

Agenda (20m):
- 0-3m: Quick wins & shoutouts
- 3-10m: Top 3 operational risks and mitigation plan
- 10-16m: Cross-team asks / decisions needed
- 16-20m: Action items, owners, and deadlines

Quick wins / wins-to-flag:
- Serving-runtime: rollout of kernel selection fallback to older CUDA on two Dedicated pools completed; burst failures dropped 82% for those customers (Kenji).
- Observability: new trace sampling toggle landed in staging (Marina) — reduced ingestion by ~30% in internal tests.
- Console: rollout of per-route latency heatmap prototype to internal users today (Priya) — early feedback positive.

Top 3 risks (high-level):
1) Capacity mismatch in us-west-2 during nightly reruns — seen 15% request requeue rate (risk: customer p99 spikes).
   - Mitigation: temporary autoscale-policy bump for Dedicated pools 3 and 4; fallback routing policy enabled to eu-west for tolerant customers. Owner: Ethan. ETA: 2027-07-13 18:00 UTC.
   - Note: needs SRE approval for cross-region routing for 2 enterprise accounts — queued with SRE (Talia).

2) Regression in token-caching correctness discovered on a small prompt subset after quantized-kv cache change (risk: silent hallucination in long-context customers).
   - Triage: Serving-runtime team to pin affected model variants back to previous cache code path; rollback PR prepared: runtime PR #1876. Owner: Kenji. ETA: hotfix by 2027-07-12 EOD.
   - Action: notify CS for customers with flagged eval sets. Owner: Marina.

3) Observability retention cost spike projected for Aug if current sampling defaults stay (risk: increased infra spend > budget).
   - Proposal: implement per-project conditional retention and sample-by-route. PoC scheduled. Owner: Marina. Decision needed by 2027-07-19.

Cross-team asks / decisions:
- Console needs an API change (minor) to expose per-request cache-hit metadata for frontend visualizations. Breaks backward compat if done as-is. Decision: add header-only opt-in for now. Owner: Priya. Target: PR by 2027-07-15.
- Dedicated asks infra for a temporary GPU quota increase for an enterprise pilot starting 2027-07-20. Finance approval needed for short-term commit. Owner: Ethan to escalate.
- Private deployments team requests a hardening checklist for new release (audit + KMS rotation). Owner: Kenji + Security.

Data snapshot (quick metrics):
- Platform availability (7d rolling): 99.96%
- p50/p95/p99 latency for text-gen (hosted): 18ms / 120ms / 420ms
- Avg tokens/sec per GPU (dedicated pool 3): 64k
- Ingest cost variance week-over-week: +12% (observability sampling changes partially responsible)

Decisions made in this bridge:
- Approve temporary autoscale-policy bump in us-west-2 for pools 3/4 until 2027-07-17. Owner: Ethan.
- Approve header-only opt-in for cache-hit metadata to unblock Console. Owner: Aisha (fast-track).
- Do not change default observability sampling yet — require PoC with cost calc first. Owner: Marina.

Open questions / follow-ups (quick list):
- Which customers must be excluded from cross-region fallback due to data residency? (Action: CS to provide list. Owner: Priya. Due: 2027-07-14)
- Do we have a runbook for KV-cache rollback across dedicated clusters? (Action: Kenji to draft).
- Finance: can we get temporary burst capacity funds for Dedicated pilot? (Ethan to confirm by 2027-07-14)

Blockers requiring exec attention:
- One enterprise customer (Acme Health) will need a signed amendment to allow eu-west fallback — legal review needed fast. (Affects: autoscale bump decision).

Action items (owner / due / notes):
- Ethan: apply autoscale bump us-west-2 pools 3/4; coordinate with SRE for cross-region traffic — due 2027-07-13 18:00 UTC.
- Kenji: merge runtime rollback PR #1876 and run canary on staging; prepare rollback runbook — due 2027-07-12 EOD.
- Marina: spin up PoC for per-project retention sampling and cost model — due 2027-07-19.
- Priya: console PR for header opt-in to expose cache metadata; notify CS of UI change — due 2027-07-15.
- Talia: confirm legal path for Acme Health amendment and report back — due 2027-07-14.

Notes-to-self / informal:
- Keep weekly cadence for Org Bridge but shorten to 15m if all items are low friction.
- Consider a recurring "risk heat" quick chart in Notion to avoid rehashing same items.
- Capture a small post-mortem for the token-caching issue even if hotfix ships.

Quick wins to celebrate next week (suggested):
- Target show-and-tell of Console heatmap at next Eng All-Hands if backend header opt-in works without perf impact.
- Publish a one-page summary of rollback runbook for Dedicated leads.

Appendix (links and references):
- Incident note (internal): /incidents/2027-07-12-token-cache-regression
- Runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1876
- Jira: ENG-4821 (autoscale-policy bump request), ENG-4999 (observability sampling PoC)

End of notes.

-- Aisha
